title: Name It, Tag It, Group It — Variable, Data Type, and Data Structure

responses.videoreflect: The labeling for the data when typing it in python has been familiar already when we were doing the pre work. It showed me data types and how it would be written in code.
responses.interviewexplain: A data type describes the variable being labeled a certain value and data structure organizes a bunch of value for one singular unit.
responses.strategy: I kept mixing up variable and data type because I thought the labels were variables, but they were just a way to describe the variable. Variable were the ones collecting values and being able to put a name for those values and give it importance.
responses.clue: The difference between one single value in the row shows you only one specific information given to you for the day but can't determine anything about that household, while the entire row holding all four pieces of information together shows you the whole log of the household that can help you determine their routine and if they qualify for a holiday box.
